items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I liked Kate Smith better than anybody, you know. I thought her voice was so beautiful, you see. And I could actually sing just like her, you know.

ctx.x: when I was born, see. I was born four and a half pounds overweight, see. I was 12 and 1/2 pounds at birth. That's generally -- the normal, see, at birth was 8 and 1/2 pounds. That was considered a healthy baby, see. So -- so anyhow this announcer was saying, 'Well, what are you doing singing like Kate Smith, you know? That's a woman, you know.'

I liked Kate Smith better than anybody, you know. I thought her voice was so beautiful, you see. And I could actually sing just like her, you know. And where I was fascinated about it was because I knew all the words, the 'When the Moon Comes Over the Mountain,' you see.
